format: NDCA eligibility complaint at the event (future NDCA body profile)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: A complaint about a competitor's eligibility received just before or at an event is not dealt with until the whole event ends, then taken up if deemed necessary by the NDCA Grievance and Disciplinary Committee.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must defer such complaints to after the event and route them to the NDCA Grievance and Disciplinary Committee (a different body from the Ballroom Department named in IV.C.9).
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile. No DanceFlow action, status or workflow models it; the existing 'Excluded (organizer decision)' action (CF1 A5) is organizer policy and is never a substitute.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-23. III.D.47 names the Grievance & Disciplinary Committee while IV.C.9 names the Ballroom Department for eligibility disputes; the relation between the two routes (complaint versus dispute, committee versus department) needs an NDCA reading.
